He is known for his long-standing performance and has gained a reputation as one of the greatest ''Counter-Strike'' players of all time. He is best known for his four years of tenure with [[Fnatic]], which he helped bring to prominence as the dominant team of 2009 and broke the record for the highest-earning team in a calendar year for ''[[Counter-Strike]]'' at the time, as well as his almost decade-long stint with [[Ninjas in Pyjamas]] that saw the team creating an invincible dynasty in the early days of ''[[Global Offensive]]'' with a record 87-map win streak. f0rest would announce his retirement in August 2024, ending a career spanning over 2 decades. In September 2019 he stepped down from [[Ninjas in Pyjamas]] after over seven years of playing under their banner, during which he participated in five consecutive [[Majors|Major]] finals – winning [[ESL/One/2014/Cologne|ESL One Cologne 2014]] – and the historic 87-0 map win streak on LAN. He reunited with former [[Ninjas in Pyjamas|NiP]] teammates Patrik "[[f0rest]]" Lindberg, Richard "[[Xizt]]" Landström, Adam "[[friberg]]" Friberg, and Robin "[[Fifflaren]]" Johansson in a revamped [[Dignitas]] lineup in January 2020. {{cite web|url=http://dignitas.gg/articles/news/CSGO/14152/a-new-dynasty-welcome-dig-csgo|title=A New Dynasty {{!}} Welcome DIG CS:GO|date=2020-01-21|publisher=[[Dignitas]]|author=[[sapphiRe]]}} He announced his retirement on January 16, 2021, ending a career spanning over 14 years. He is regarded as one of the most consistent players in the competitive scene and is known for his clutch ability. His partnership with [[olofmeister]] during [[Fnatic]]'s dominant period from late 2014 to early 2016 is regarded as one of the best duos in ''Counter-Strike'' history. KRIMZ joined Fnatic in 2014 and spent almost his entire career there, broken only by a three month stint with [[GODSENT]] in 2016. He is among the most decorated players in ''Global Offensive'' history, winning over 20 [[S-Tier Tournaments|S-Tier]] tournaments across his career. Among these accomplishments include two [[Majors]]. '''Counter-Strike 2'''{{TH|2025-01-10 — '''Present'''|Team Vitality}} }} Robin "'''ropz'''" Kool {{born}} is an [[:Category:Estonia|Estonian]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' player and a former ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' player who currently plays for [[Team Vitality]]. ropz plays primarily as a rifler and [[:Category:Lurkers|lurker]], a role where he is considered to be one of the greatest of all time. ropz is among the most decorated ''CS:GO'' and ''CS2'' players, having won over 25 [[S-Tier Tournaments|S-Tier]] tournaments across his career, including three [[Majors|Major championships]] and a record three [[ESL/Grand Slam|ESL Grand Slams]]. He is also regarded as one of the greatest riflers of all time, having been ranked in every [[HLTV/Top_20_Players|HLTV Top 20 ranking]] since his debut, peaking at #3 in 2023 and 2025. ==Gear and '''Counter-Strike 2'''{{TH|2023-10-26 — 2025-07-28|Natus Vincere|Inactive}} {{TH|2024-09-27 — 2024-11-21|Team Falcons|Loan}} {{TH|2025-05-05 — 2025-07-09|FaZe Clan|Loan}} {{TH|2025-07-28 — '''Present'''|BC.Game Esports}} }} Oleksandr "'''s1mple'''" Kostyliev {{born}} is a [[:Category:Ukraine|Ukrainian]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' player and a former professional ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' player. Widely considered as the greatest and most accomplished ''[[CS:GO]]'' player of all time, he has won 21 [[HLTV/MVP Awards|HLTV MVP]] medals, a [[PGL Major Stockholm 2021|Major]] and an [[Intel/Grand_Slam/3|Intel Grand Slam]] trophy, among other numerous [[:Category:S-Tier Tournaments|S-Tier trophies]], and has been crowned as the best player of 2018, 2021, and 2022, and the runner-up for the best player of 2019 and 2020. In late 2023, s1mple announced he would be taking a break from competition, benching himself on [[Natus Vincere]], where he had played since 2017; citing personal reasons and a dislike towards the state of ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' at the time. Around one year later, s1mple would have a short loan stint with [[Team Falcons]] and later [[FaZe Clan]], before completing a shock transfer to [[BC.Game Esports|BC.Game]] in mid 2025.
